data.summary: Five journeys (Read, Learn, Prepare, Find, Build) now organise the site; a single search covers essays, sacred texts down to the verse, Interview Studio, companies and demos; the Atlas shows how they connect; and the homepage can pick up where you left off — from this browser's own history, never a server.
data.title: PaddySpeaks becomes one connected platform

data.summary: Every sacred-text app now has a Sources & Verification panel that says honestly where its text came from — including when that is not recorded. A public corrections log lists meaningful fixes. Every public statistic is now derived from the content itself, which corrected the question, data-model and sacred-text counts that had drifted.
data.title: Sources, corrections and one source of truth for every number

data.summary: Pages that promised 'no tracking' or 'nothing uploaded' while loading analytics were corrected; the Privacy Console gained a step-by-step data-flow section and dropped its tracking pixel; the analytics server now honours Global Privacy Control for every request. A plain-language privacy policy, terms, disclaimer and copyright page were added.
data.title: Privacy claims now match the code, and a privacy policy

data.summary: The site's API now only answers the site's own pages, compares the admin password in constant time and locks out repeated wrong guesses, meters the privacy scan proxy and re-checks every redirect it follows, and deletes expired leaderboard data daily. CI now scans for committed secrets and audits dependencies.
data.title: API hardening, secret scanning and backups

data.summary: Search is now a proper keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible dialog; every page gets a visible focus ring, a skip link and reduced motion on request; sacred-text search boxes are labelled. An automated WCAG 2.2 check runs on every change and may not get worse.
data.title: Accessibility baseline

data.summary: A job search whose promise is that every role is still live on the employer's own careers page, re-checked every four hours. Reposts are labelled as reposts with their history, never as newly posted, and search keeps to the role you asked for.
data.title: JobSignal launches — jobs that still exist

data.summary: About 9% of roles showed a place that does not exist. Multi-location postings now list every place, and each city has one spelling.
data.title: JobSignal: locations corrected

data.summary: Seventeen verses gained word-by-word breakdowns, interpretation and cross-links to the Lalitha Sahasranama. Inherited English meanings found to be misaligned are labelled as under review rather than presented as settled.
data.title: Abhirami Andhadhi becomes a layered interpretation

data.summary: A story in nine scenes about how professional discovery is changing when an agent, not a recruiter, reads your profile first.
data.title: New interactive essay: AI Is Looking For You

data.summary: The AI Executive Command Center, Revenue Leakage & Margin Intelligence Hub and Enterprise Resilience War Room join the Lakehouse demo — each on clearly labelled synthetic data.
data.title: Three executive AI & data demos

data.summary: A visual field guide to the 2026 hiring market: how to tell whether a role is real, who is behind it, and how to get from 'Apply' to a conversation.
data.title: New essay: The Job Posting Is Not the Job

data.summary: A modelled look at sixty years of Bay Area housing against income, rebuilt after a source-by-source review; the article carries its own dated corrections note.

data.summary: A new series, one song per article: Telugu text and transliteration, word-by-word meanings, ragam and talam where sources agree (and the disagreement where they do not), and curated listening.
